name: SaleGen Marketing Toolkit – CRM, Email Marketing, Forms & Popups
author: wpSaleGen

sections.description:
Welcome to SaleGen Marketing Toolkit!

Capture leads, manage contacts, and run email marketing — all inside WordPress.

An all-in-one email marketing and marketing automation plugin for WordPress.

Create forms, popups, manage contacts, and send email campaigns — all from one place, without relying on multiple plugins or external services.

Fast, flexible, and designed for real-world marketing workflows.

Learn more: wpsalegen.com

SaleGen Marketing Toolkit – Contacts, Forms, Popups, Email Campaigns

  • Contacts (CRM)
  • Email Campaigns & Automations
  • Form Builder
  • Popup Builder

🚀 What you can do

  • Create contact forms, opt-in forms, and lead generation forms
  • Build popups with advanced triggers and targeting
  • Manage contacts in a built-in CRM with tags and custom fields
  • Send email campaigns and automation sequences
  • Use your own SMTP or IMAP mail server
  • Track submissions, events, and contact activity

📦 Core modules

Contacts (CRM)
Manage contacts with custom fields, tags, import/export, and activity history.

Form Builder
Create contact forms, registration flows, and lead capture forms with validation, anti-spam, and tracking.

Popup Builder
Build popups for lead generation, announcements, and offers using triggers like time, scroll, and exit intent.

Email Campaigns & Automations
Send newsletters, create automation chains, and manage email workflows with reusable templates.

⚙️ Additional modules and tools

Dashboard
Central control panel to manage modules, mail configs, and global settings.

Files Manager
Manage uploaded files linked to contacts, forms, and submissions from one place.

Mail Configs
Create reusable email configurations for different workflows.

✉️ Email and communication

  • Custom SMTP configuration
  • Optional IMAP mailbox integration
  • Reusable mail configs
  • Queue-based email sending
  • Contact email chat (mailbox-based workflows)

🔌 Supported email providers

Free version:
* Custom SMTP
* Custom IMAP

PRO:
* Mailbox providers: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoho Mail, Fastmail
* Delivery providers: SendGrid, Mailgun, Brevo, Postmark, Amazon SES

📊 Built for growth

  • Track form submissions and popup events
  • Monitor email activity and campaign performance
  • View contact history, logs, and engagement data
  • Use segmentation and conditions in automation flows

🔒 Secure and flexible

  • Frontend and backend validation
  • Spam protection (Honeypot + Google reCAPTCHA v2)
  • Works with Gutenberg and popular page builders
  • Lightweight and modular architecture

🔌 PRO features

The free plugin is fully usable. PRO adds:

  • Advanced automation and segmentation
  • Provider integrations
  • WooCommerce integration
  • Extended CRM field types and workflows

💡 Why choose SaleGen Marketing Toolkit?

  • All-in-one marketing system inside WordPress
  • No need for multiple plugins
  • No dependency on external SaaS platforms
  • Full control over your data and email delivery
  • Built for real marketing workflows

External services

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/salegen-marketing-toolkit/ directory, or install via WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open the SaleGen Marketing Toolkit menu in admin and configure modules.
sections.faq:
Is SaleGen Marketing Toolkit free?

Yes. The free version includes CRM, Forms, Popups, and Email Campaigns. PRO adds advanced features.

Who is this plugin for?

For site owners, marketers, and developers who want a complete marketing system inside WordPress.

Can I use this instead of multiple plugins?

Yes. It replaces separate CRM, form, popup, and email plugins.

Can forms create or update contacts?

Yes. Forms map directly to CRM fields.

Can I import/export contacts?

Yes, via CSV.

Can I create unlimited forms and popups?

Yes.

Does it support email campaigns and automation?

Yes, including multi-step automation chains.

Can I use my own SMTP?

Yes, SMTP and PHP mail() are supported.

Does it support IMAP and email replies?

Yes. IMAP can be used for mailbox workflows and replies.

What is Email Chat?

A mailbox-based system to read and reply to contact emails inside WordPress.

Can I use different mail configs?

Yes, reusable configs can be assigned to different workflows.

Does it support providers like SendGrid?

Yes, in PRO.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes. PRO adds deeper integration and dynamic data.

Does it support file uploads?

Yes. Files can be managed in a dedicated module.

Is it secure?

Yes. Includes validation and spam protection.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes.

Do I need external services?

No. You can run everything on your own server.

Where is data stored?

Inside your WordPress database.

1.4.0

  • New: Reusable Mail Configs (SMTP / IMAP) with connection testing and usage across forms, chats, and automations
  • New: Provider-based email architecture in admin
  • New: Contact Email Chat with IMAP threads, message viewer, and replies
  • New: Enhanced Contact CRM history (logs, field changes, timeline, tags)
  • New: Contact-level campaign visibility and improved statistics
  • New: Custom CSS / JS support in builders (foundation)
  • New: Dark admin theme with light/dark toggle
  • Improved: Forms, Popups, Email Templates, and Chain Steps editors UX
  • Improved: Mail sending consistency via selected configs
  • Improved: Dashboard, navigation, and admin UI consistency
  • Improved: Contact edit screen (metadata, logs, campaigns view)
  • Improved: Shared admin components (inputs, tables, editors, notices)
  • Fixed: Form and popup preview issues
  • Fixed: Field persistence edge cases
  • Fixed: Provider connection UX issues
  • Fixed: Dark theme contrast and UI inconsistencies

1.3.0 – 1.3.2

  • New: Full dark admin theme with persistent toggle
  • New: Multi-mailbox support (SMTP / IMAP configs)
  • New: Contact Email Chat with IMAP sync and replies
  • New: Contact analytics (logs, timeline, field history, tags)
  • New: Statistics for Forms, Popups, Chains, and Contacts
  • New: Chain contacts tab, step stats, and quick actions
  • New: Improved PRO discovery (banners, modules, upgrade prompts)
  • Improved: Dark UI consistency across all modules
  • Improved: Chain editor layout and behavior
  • Improved: Popup builder option refresh logic
  • Improved: Preview modals (ESC close support)
  • Improved: Color picker input sync
  • Improved: Forms and fields behavior consistency
  • Improved: General UX and performance
  • Fixed: Dark mode UI inconsistencies
  • Fixed: Theme toggle rendering
  • Fixed: Popup positioning and menu highlighting
  • Fixed: Email/chat sync and mail config handling
  • Fixed: Builder and contact field edge cases

1.2.0

  • New: Pre-built templates for Forms, Popups, and Email Templates
  • New: Live preview in builders
  • Improved: General improvements
  • Fixed: Minor issues

1.1.0 – 1.1.4

  • New: Email Campaigns & Automations module
  • New: Manual bounce handling (SMTP / IMAP)
  • New: Auto-tagging for failed email contacts
  • Improved: General improvements
  • Fixed: Minor issues

1.0.0 – 1.0.5

  • New: Initial release (Contacts, Forms, Popups)
  • Improved: Plugin description and rating flow
  • Fixed: Minor issues
